transcript: Speaker A: वाणी लोग कहते हैं English का master बनना है तो पहले इस भारी-भरकम grammar book को घोल कर पीना पड़ेगा। क्या यह सच है? [Vani, people say if you want to master English, you first have to gulp down this heavy grammar book. Is this true?] Speaker B: अरे तौबा-तौबा, यह book फेंक दो please. यह बहुत बड़ा अफवाह है। जब बचपन में Hindi बोलना सीखा था, तो क्या पैदा होते ही व्याकरण की book चाटी थी? [Oh my goodness, please throw this book away. This is a huge myth. When you learned to speak Hindi in childhood, did you lick a grammar book right after birth?] Speaker A: अरे बिल्कुल नहीं। वो तो मम्मी-पापा को सुन-सुनकर अपने आप आ गई। [Oh, absolutely not. That came naturally by listening to mom and dad.] Speaker B: Exactly! भाषा बोलने से आती है, रट्टा मारने से नहीं। तो book बंद करो और मेरे साथ सीधे बातचीत शुरू करो। [Exactly! Language comes from speaking, not from rote learning. So close the book and start talking directly with me.] Speaker C: अभी Speakeasy app download करें और फर्राटेदार English बोलना शुरू करें। [Download the Speakeasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]
on_screen_text: Speakeasy AI. Speak English Easily with Speakeasy. Install Now. GET IT ON Google Play.
summary: A man asks an AI avatar if learning English requires memorizing grammar books. The AI debunks this, explaining that languages are learned naturally through speaking, not rote memorization. The ad invites users to download the Speakeasy app to practice speaking English.
